shortDescription: create, update, or destroy Automation Platform Controller workflow job templates.

options.name: allow_simultaneous
options.description: Allow simultaneous runs of the workflow job template.

options.name: ask_inventory_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for inventory on launch of this workflow job template

options.name: ask_labels_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for labels on launch.

options.name: ask_limit_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for limit on launch of this workflow job template

options.name: ask_scm_branch_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for SCM branch on launch of this workflow job template

options.name: ask_skip_tags_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for job tags to skip on launch.

options.name: ask_tags_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for job tags on launch.

options.name: ask_variables_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for C(extra_vars) on launch.

options.name: controller_config_file
options.description: Path to the controller config file. If provided, the other locations for config files will not be considered.

options.name: controller_host
options.description: URL to your Automation Platform Controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_HOST) and then config files If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: controller_oauthtoken
options.description: The OAuth token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_OAUTH_TOKEN) and then config files

options.name: controller_password
options.description: Password for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_PASSWORD) and then config files

options.name: controller_username
options.description: Username for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_USERNAME) and then config files

options.name: copy_from
options.description: Name or id to copy the workflow job template from. This will copy an existing workflow job template and change any parameters supplied. The new workflow job template name will be the one provided in the name parameter. The organization parameter is not used in this, to facilitate copy from one organization to another. Provide the id or use the lookup plugin to provide the id if multiple workflow job templates share the same name.

options.name: description
options.description: Optional description of this workflow job template.

options.name: destroy_current_nodes
options.description: Set in order to destroy current workflow_nodes on the workflow. This option is used for full workflow update, if not used, nodes not described in workflow will persist and keep current associations and links.

options.name: extra_vars
options.description: Variables which will be made available to jobs ran inside the workflow.

options.name: inventory
options.description: Name, ID, or named URL of inventory applied as a prompt, assuming job template prompts for inventory

options.name: job_tags
options.description: Comma separated list of the tags to use for the job template.

options.name: labels
options.description: The labels applied to this job template Must be created with the labels module first. This will error if the label has not been created.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit applied as a prompt, assuming job template prompts for limit

options.name: name
options.description: Name of this workflow job template.

options.name: new_name
options.description: Setting this option will change the existing name.

options.name: notification_templates_approvals
options.description: list of notifications to send on approval

options.name: notification_templates_error
options.description: list of notifications to send on error

options.name: notification_templates_started
options.description: list of notifications to send on start

options.name: notification_templates_success
options.description: list of notifications to send on success

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization name, ID, or named URL the workflow job template exists in. Used to help lookup the object, cannot be modified using this module. If not provided, will lookup by name only, which does not work with duplicates.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the controller host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code

options.name: scm_branch
options.description: SCM branch applied as a prompt, assuming job template prompts for SCM branch

options.name: skip_tags
options.description: Comma separated list of the tags to skip for the job template.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: survey_enabled
options.description: Setting that variable will prompt the user for job type on the workflow launch.

options.name: survey_spec
options.description: The definition of the survey associated to the workflow.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to AWX. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_VERIFY_SSL) and then config files

options.name: webhook_credential
options.description: Personal Access Token for posting back the status to the service API

options.name: webhook_service
options.description: Service that webhook requests will be accepted from

options.name: workflow_nodes
options.description: A json list of nodes and their coresponding options. The following suboptions describe a single node.
